selection_rationale: Higher 100-seed F1/PR-AUC and chronological F1 with 29 rather than 64 features.
Higher 100-seed F1 and much stronger woman-weighted chronology using 29 rather than 157 features; retain longitudinal ExtraTrees as sensitivity comparator.
Core F1 gain was only 0.0001 while recall and chronological F1 fell materially; keep engineered Elastic Net.
Core shrinkage LDA improves ranking metrics, but precision and bootstrap lower bound remain inadequate for automatic calls.
